The later completion therefore cannot be used without guessing.
notes.normalized_observation: A later plant commercialization is visible, but its binding to Mahad and timing against the promised quarter are not proven.

notes.timing_interpretation: Later evidence reports the broader digital-first portfolio above INR1,000 crore ARR, but the frozen target applies to two referenced brands. The packet does not establish that those exact two brands alone crossed INR1,000 crore, and 'this year' is also ambiguous.
notes.normalized_observation: The broader portfolio exceeded INR1,000 crore ARR, but the exact two-brand target is not established.

notes.timing_interpretation: Exchange evidence explicitly reports FY26 constant-currency growth of 3.1% versus the frozen 1%-3% guidance band. Because H003-O001 did not freeze directionality for economically favorable overshoots above target_max, classifying 3.1% as either MET or MISSED would introduce post-outcome semantics. The result therefore fails closed to UNRESOLVED.
notes.normalized_observation: FY26 constant-currency growth was 3.1%, slightly above the guidance maximum, but favorable-overshoot treatment was not frozen.
